title: File:Red Jacket and Shirt Designed by Darryl Harris and Worn by Cecilia Nadal at the Powell Symphony Hall Performance of the China National Orchestra - DPLA - cb9b1888460470c66b31010d2da61eda (page 4).jpg
desc: Red gown designed by Darryl Harris of St. Louis. The gown was worn by Cecilia Nadal to the 2000 performance of the China National Orchestra at Powell Symphony Hall. Nadal was instrumental in bringing the orchestra to St. Louis.
